title: Tech Note: Filtering Methods and Forms in the 4D V6 Label Wizard

historical_commentary.text: This note addresses a real V6-era usability/safety concern: the Label Wizard's default drop-down lists exposed the entire database's forms and project methods to end users, risking accidental data corruption; the underlying design lesson (never expose raw internal developer artifacts to end users unfiltered) remains valid, but the specific Label Wizard, Label Editor, and V6-era forms/methods model it describes have been superseded by many generations of 4D form design and reporting tools since.
related_updates: The 4D V6-era Label Wizard and Label Editor have been superseded by modern 4D form design, list forms, and reporting/printing capabilities in later versions

Project Mode (introduced v17, 2018) and modern method/form organization (packages, components) provide different, more granular ways to control what end users can select than the V6-era filtering workaround described here
